title: Accepting a Change in Health
paragraphs: Setelah cedera secara permanen membatasi kemampuannya bermain olahraga seperti dulu, Rafi berjuang selama berbulan-bulan dengan frustrasi, tidak bisa menerima bahwa tubuhnya tidak akan kembali ke kondisi sebelumnya.

Seorang kerabat yang lebih tua yang pernah menghadapi keterbatasan serupa bertahun-tahun lalu berbagi bahwa penerimaan tidak berarti menyerah sepenuhnya, melainkan menyesuaikan ekspektasinya sambil percaya ada hikmah dalam keadaan barunya.

Perlahan, Rafi mulai menjelajahi aktivitas fisik lain yang lebih sesuai dengan keterbatasan barunya, menemukan kesenangan tak terduga dalam sesuatu yang tidak akan pernah ia coba jika kemampuan aslinya tetap tidak berubah.

Melihat ke belakang setahun kemudian, Rafi mengakui bahwa menerima perubahan itu, alih-alih terus-menerus melawannya, memungkinkannya menemukan versi kehidupan aktif yang belum pernah ia pertimbangkan sebelumnya.
answerKey: After an injury permanently limited his ability to play sports the way he once had, Rafi struggled for months with frustration, unable to accept that his body would not return to its previous condition. An older relative who had faced a similar limitation years earlier shared that acceptance did not mean giving up entirely, but adjusting his expectations while trusting there was wisdom in his new circumstances. Slowly, Rafi began exploring other physical activities better suited to his new limitations, finding unexpected enjoyment in something he would never have tried had his original ability remained unchanged. Looking back a year later, Rafi admitted that accepting the change, rather than continuously fighting against it, allowed him to discover a version of an active life he had not previously considered.
